crossRefs.note: The land was defiled. Therefore I punished its iniquity, and the land vomited out her inhabitants.
“ ‘You shall therefore keep all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them, that the land where I am bringing you…
For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, ‘How we are ruined! We are greatly confounded because we have forsaken the…
“ ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because they say to you, ‘You are a devourer of men, and have been a bereaver of your nation;’
“Son of man, when the house of Israel lived in their own land, they defiled it by their ways and by their deeds. Their…
For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.
So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will vomit you out of my mouth.

translations.web: that the land not vomit you out also, when you defile it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.
translations.bsb: So if you defile the land, it will vomit you out as it spewed out the nations before you.
translations.kjv: That the land spue not you out also, when ye defile it, as it spued out the nations that were before
translations.asv: that the land vomit not you out also, when ye defile it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.
